ledger.claim: The rider's presence is undecidable on this record and must be treated as neutral, not as absence. All 88 rider fixes in the trace report 45 to 80 m horizontal accuracy and are excluded by the same 25 m accuracy filter that POL-NS-04(c) applies as POL-NS-02 applies it to the driver, leaving rider_qualifying_fix_count at 0. Limb (c) therefore cannot be run, and under POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-11 an absent or fully filtered rider track is UNDECIDABLE - neither satisfied nor failed - so no finding may be built on the rider's own device. Nothing admissible places the rider away from the pickup, and the record cannot support a finding that he was elsewhere.

The only artifacts capable of showing the rider was on notice are impaired, and I disclose the impairment rather than present the log as clean: EV-CHAT-00202 carries issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE at weight 0.85, and its payload confirms that the system arrival notice at 23:13:11 and both driver messages at 23:14:02 and 23:19:30 all carry read_at null. Under POL-GEN-02(1) the log shows delivery, not receipt. The driver's account of a wait the rider saw and ignored rests on an artifact that cannot establish it, while the rider's account - that he saw no messages until later, being still inside the terminal after a delayed flight - is unrebutted on this bundle.

ledger.claim: I do not press a dwell attack or a false-arrival attack, and I say so plainly rather than stretch them. The derived arrival facts record run_count 1 and a single continuous in-geofence run of 620 seconds from 23:12:45 to 23:23:05, which is above the 480 second AIRPORT minimum, so POL-NS-06's shortfall route is not open to the rider; and the trace places the driver continuously inside the 150 m arrival radius with max_excursion_m null, so POL-NS-05's 300 m and 15 km/h triggers are not made out. The rider's case therefore rests on what the record leaves open - his undecidable presence and the driver's uncorroborated narrative - and not on the arithmetic of the dwell.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the driver's own evidence. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 480 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, which agrees with fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec for the AIRPORT zone class). The trace, at a 10-second cadence with 100 percent coverage and no gaps (max_gap_sec 0.0), places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius for a single continuous qualifying run of 620 seconds - 63 qualifying fixes running from 2026-07-24T23:12:45+08:00 to 23:23:05+08:00. That is 140 seconds more than the policy requires, and the dwell is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as limb (c) directs, not from the arrival tap.

Limb (b) is satisfied. The first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 23:12:45, 25 seconds before the trip record's 'arrived' event at 23:13:10 (derived.arrival.dwell_start_offset_sec = 25.0), so the trace places the driver inside the POL-NS-02 pickup geofence at or before the timestamp of that event. The AIRPORT radius is 150 m, and the driver's fixes qualify against it - the nearest fix in the whole driver track is 22.4 m from the pin.

Limb (d) is satisfied. The trip record carries no boarding event and records a termination by the driver at 23:23:20 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three codes limb (d) recognises - and that termination falls after the 480-second required dwell, measured from the first qualifying fix at 23:12:45, had elapsed at 23:20:45. platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold has to be met. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold and the $6.00 fee is chargeable.

POL-NS-05 does not bite: the arrival marker is not false. At the 23:13:10 marker the driver was inside his in-geofence run, not before it, so he was neither more than 300 m from the pin nor travelling at 15 km/h or above; his nearest approach across the trip is 22.4 m. Even if the clock were recomputed from the first qualifying fix, the corrected dwell of 620 seconds still exceeds the 480-second minimum, which is precisely the situation POL-NS-05(iii) covers - a false marker does not by itself defeat a fee whose corrected dwell was served.

POL-NS-06 does not apply. The clause refunds only where the effective in-geofence dwell falls short of the free waiting period in force; here the measured run is 620 seconds against 480 seconds required, a surplus of 140 seconds (derived.arrival.shortfall_sec of -140.0 computed on longest_run_sec). There is no shortfall to refund, so the rider has no route to the fee through this clause.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because limb (a) fails at the first step. Limb (a) requires a rider message during the waiting window whose content is locating or coordinating; the chat log for this trip contains exactly three messages and none is from the rider - MSG-00202-001 is the system 'Your driver has arrived' notice and MSG-00202-002 and MSG-00202-003 are the driver's own ('boss i'm at door 5 T3 arrival'; 'boss? still waiting ah'). With limb (a) failed the clause does not engage. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00202 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 on issue UNREAD_MESSAGE (all three messages carry read_at null); the impairment bears on whether the rider saw the messages, not on limb (a), which turns on the sender field alone, and no deciding fact of this case rests on this artifact.

The rider's own track decides nothing, and its undecidability is neutral rather than adverse to the driver. All 88 rider fixes report 45 m to 80 m horizontal accuracy - worse than the 25 m filter POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-04(c) share - so rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0. Under POL-NS-11, limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is UNDECIDABLE: neither satisfied nor failed, POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, the missing qualifying rider track does not impair the driver's arrival or dwell evidence, and the dispute is decided on the driver's own evidence. I do not assert that the rider was absent; the record does not say so, and the fee does not turn on it.

No traffic advisory is asserted and none is needed. EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 - no advisory covers the Changi Airport kerbside in this window - and its absence is citable as such. The driver does not claim an accumulation under POL-NS-06(i): the trace shows one unbroken in-geofence interval of 620 seconds, so no summing of separate intervals arises and no advisory is required to support the dwell that limb (c) of POL-NS-01 measures.

POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so the driver is compensated at 80 percent of the fee in force - 80 percent of $6.00 is $4.80, which is the figure the fare breakdown itself derives. ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: the $6.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00202 stands, and the driver is paid $4.80 of it. Here is why, and what it means for each of you.

The fee is chargeable only if all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold. They do. (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 23:13:10 (EV-TRIP-00202). (b) The GPS trace places the driver inside the Changi Terminal 3 AIRPORT geofence before that event: the first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 23:12:45, 25 seconds earlier, on a trace with 100% coverage and no gaps (EV-GPS-00202). (c) The free waiting period in force for this trip is 480 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The driver held position inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius for one continuous qualifying run of 620 seconds, from 23:12:45 to 23:23:05, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as the clause directs - 140 seconds more than required. (d) No boarding event is recorded, and the driver terminated the trip at 23:23:20 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell elapsed at 23:20:45. platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies. The arrival marker was not false: at 23:13:10 the driver was already inside the geofence and stationary, so neither the 300 m nor the 15 km/h trigger of POL-NS-05 fires, and no false-arrival referral is produced. POL-NS-06 does not apply either, because there was no shortfall to refund.

Rider, your account that your flight from Bangkok was delayed and that you were inside the terminal the whole time is not contradicted by anything in the record, and I accept that you did not see the messages before the cancellation. But the policy gives a refund on this ground only where you sent a locating or coordinating message during the waiting window and the driver did not answer it (POL-NS-04). No message in the chat log (EV-CHAT-00202) was sent by you - the three messages are the system arrival notice and the driver's two messages - so limb (a) of that clause fails at the first step and the clause cannot exonerate you. I also note that EV-CHAT-00202 is impaired at weight 0.85 (issue UNREAD_MESSAGE: all three messages carry read_at null), which confirms delivery only, not receipt; that impairment does not change the outcome, because limb (a) turns on the sender field alone and no deciding fact of this case rests on the chat log. Your own device track (all 88 fixes report 45-80 m accuracy and are filtered out) leaves your presence UNDECIDABLE rather than adverse to you, per POL-NS-04(c) and POL-NS-11; I make no finding that you were away from the pickup.

Driver, your narrative that you waited and messaged is corroborated by the trace and the chat log, and the fee is not displaced by any clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06. Under POL-NS-07 you are paid 80% of the $6.00 fee in force, which is $4.80 - the same figure the fare breakdown derives (EV-FARE-00202). The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1/168 completed trips is 0.006 (below 0.08). EV-DPROF-00202 is impaired at weight 0.9 (SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH); the two counters it supplies for that check sit an order of magnitude below both thresholds, and the impairment does not change the result - it only caps my confidence at 0.90. I note EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0): no traffic advisory covers the kerbside in this window, and no accumulation of separate intervals under POL-NS-06(i) was asserted or needs to be.

No escalation applies. There is no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts on arrival or dwell; the two counterparty-dispute counters are both 0; the anti-farming check does not trip and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1; and no deciding fact rests on an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d). Nothing in the record produces a clause-mandated referral, so the referrals list is empty. The monetary effect ($4.80) is below the $8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes on issue; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
